title: Another option for anonymous text
summary:
A quiet week added an anonymous text model, eased pressure on authentication, and gave a community project proper credit.

`gemma-roblox`, backed by Nebius Gemma 2 9B IT Fast, was added for anonymous text requests with tool support and a 1,024-token output configuration.

Per-user metric writes were disabled at several request paths to reduce database contention affecting authentication, and an index was added for API token lookups. Text-generation analytics moved out of the text server and into cache-worker events; cache metadata now retains only selected request headers.

The Mimir AIP project listing now credits @CiaranMcAleer, links to its GitHub repository, and records its star count.
